name: Partially Learned Gradient Descent
aliases: Partially learned gradient descent without regularizer
definition: An iterative reconstruction method that combines a fixed physics-based gradient step with a learnable neural network update, initialized with a filtered backprojection (FBP) estimate, without using a regularization term in the network input.
summary: Partially Learned Gradient Descent unrolls optimization steps into a neural network, combining fixed physics-based gradient updates with learnable convolutional corrections for interpretable, robust image reconstruction.
